impact.text: Attackers can interact with the protocol using prices that don't reflect true market values

precondition_sources.text: The protocol is deployed on Optimism, an L2 network.
The L2 sequencer experiences downtime, during which Chainlink price feeds on L2 cannot be updated with fresh prices from mainnet.

intent_sources.text: Protocols deployed on L2 networks must implement sequencer uptime checks so that price retrieval is prevented during and immediately after sequencer downtime.
